svg.title: Mawquta Project Completion Workflow
svg.desc: A top-down workflow showing the remaining steps to complete and launch the Mawquta project, from S3-T3 operational handoff through to post-launch.
svg.text: ✓ Sprint 02 — Data Binding + Resilience ✓ S3-T1 Prod Audit ✓ S3-T2 Deployment Prep

g.text: README · Runbook · Known limits · Deployment assumptions
Target: ≤ 1 focused task | Output: 1 clean Markdown handoff doc

svg.text: 2. Config + env vars + API paths documented

g.text: Gate check — is the handoff doc complete?
Run S3-T3 Definition of Done checklist before proceeding
Host the app on a real environment (Vercel / Netlify / VPS)
Verify /api/geocode · Test startup · Confirm live runtime behavior

svg.text: 1. Choose hosting platform (Vercel recommended for /api serverless)
2. Set env vars + API paths for live environment
4. Smoke test: fresh session, location flow, prayer, qibla, ramadan
5. Verify fallback/resilience on simulated service failure

g.text: Gate check — does the app run cleanly in production?
All 3 sections live · location flow works · fallbacks calm
Dev workflow upgrade · Live Reload / vercel dev · SEO meta · Perf pass
